scope: Ogg Opus 48 kHz streaming decoder boundary, not AudioOut or game bus

contract.source: C-owned FILE callbacks or caller-borrowed immutable memory callbacks
contract.pcm: 48 kHz f32 interleaved stereo output, 960 frame fixed internal cache and <=960 output frames per call
contract.eof: zero frames only at verified logical end; seek(total) is logical EOF
contract.seekTell: sample frame offsets after Opus pre-skip, seek resets buffered PCM; out-of-range seek does not move
contract.failures: invalid arguments, I/O, malformed header, corrupt stream, allocation failure, unsupported mapping/chains and range each have distinct status
contract.ownership: C closes FILE and frees decoder via kv_audio_close; memory input remains borrowed; Rust never adopts a C allocation and handle is !Send/!Sync

verification.host: PASS C fixture mono/stereo, CRC/truncated/midstream corruption, allocation failures via malloc/calloc wrappers, EOF/seek/tell/file/memory under ASan+UBSan leak detection
verification.rust: PASS 2 Rust tests including true C FFI file and memory fixtures
verification.arm: PASS arm-vita-eabi-gcc -Wall -Wextra -Werror static executable ELF ARM EABI5 linked with opusfile/opus/ogg/m; kv_audio_open_file present
verification.targetRuntime: Not executed on Vita hardware or Vita3K

integration: Add vita/audio_decode.c to Vita CMake source list; add opusfile, opus, ogg and m to native linkage in that order.
Expose knife-platform-vita/src/audio_decode.rs from lib.rs under target_os="vita" and ensure Rust final link consumes the native C library.
Pass compact stream paths from asset layer into AudioStream::open_file; drive <=960 frame reads into a bounded game audio ring and perform voice/loop/mix policy in a separate stage.
limitations: No AudioOut, game voice scheduling, or hardware runtime validation.
CRC/EOS inspection of final Ogg page catches truncated tails; opusfile reports earlier page damage as runtime corruption.

Metadata and packet allocations are managed internally by opusfile; allocation failures map to Memory where opusfile reports OP_EFAULT. Peak library metadata memory is not capped separately from the 1 GiB encoded source bound.
The source must remain stable while a file decoder is open; memory input must remain immutable for its Rust lifetime.
